snowfall.note: Snow on the railings, a blue winter night, one lantern. Exactly it.

candlelit.note: Candles everywhere and warm gold, but the hair went grey (cool-light aging on flux).

fog.note: Dense luminous fog with haloed lanterns.

rainfall.note: Rain streaks and wet stone, a dome through the downpour; identity 0.58.

sunrise.note: White blooms and cool light; no sunrise glow.

noir.note: Dark and moody with hard light; the blinds did not appear.

opulent.note: Chandeliers, gilt and a grand gallery. A palace.

synthwave.note: Full magenta-cyan synthwave, but the face drifted hard (0.40).

autumnal.note: Autumn leaves drifting and carpeting the path. Perfect.

starlit.note: Blue night with lanterns, but grey hair again.

godrays.note: Volumetric sun rays through the haze. Breathtaking.

fireworks.note: Fireworks through the glass dome, glow on the wet floor.

carnival.note: String bulbs and festival lights; carnival without the tents.

overcast.note: Soft grey Nordic light, muted palette.

stained_glass.note: Pink and magenta colored light through the panes; grey hair.

chaos.note: Rainbow light from every direction. Wild, as written.

majestic.note: Warm lantern grandeur; close to opulent, less gilt.

aura.note: Warm glow, a tighter waist-up frame.

bioluminescent.note: Teal and magenta glowing lotuses on dark water. Otherworldly.

caustics.note: Turquoise water light, but grey hair again.
